facts.fact: The Gambia and Senegal signed an MoU on cooperation in telecommunications, ICT and the digital economy in Dakar on 12 June 2026 during the Senegalo-Gambian Presidential Council.
facts.system: Senegal-Gambia MoU on telecommunications, ICT and digital economy

facts.fact: The first Steering Committee under the Senegal-Gambia MoU met in Banjul, opened by The Gambia's communications minister, to set a roadmap; the meeting date is not given, so the published date 2026-08-24 is used.
